FIND-F-001-S1.title: Define Provider Search Schema and Contract
FIND-F-001-S1.description: Define and validate Pydantic models for provider search inputs (query, location, specialty, filters) and structured response outputs including provider metadata, relevance scores, and fallback indicators.

FIND-F-001-S2.title: Implement Vector Search with Taxonomy Fallback
FIND-F-001-S2.description: Implement provider search logic using MongoDB Atlas vector search with embedding queries, including scoring and ranking, and fallback to NUCC taxonomy-based filtering when vector results are insufficient or below threshold.

FIND-F-001-S3.title: Expose Provider Search via Find Care Facade
FIND-F-001-S3.description: Integrate provider_search_service into find_care_facade to orchestrate specialty identification, query expansion, location normalization, and search execution for tool routing and API consumption.

FIND-F-001-S4.title: Provider Search Unit and Integration Tests
FIND-F-001-S4.description: Create unit tests for provider search logic (vector ranking, fallback behavior, filtering, edge cases) and integration tests validating end-to-end flow from facade through service to MongoDB Atlas.

FIND-F-001-S5.title: Integrate Embeddings and Provider Data Pipeline
FIND-F-001-S5.description: Ensure provider search compatibility with embedding generation and provider data pipeline, including correct use of text-embedding-3-large vectors, indexed MongoDB collections, and alignment with loaded provider records.
